grouping_rule: Same frozen source path plus UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_FRAGMENT standing only.
items: README leaves Causal Permeability endpoint identity unresolved, lacks a general mathcal-G estimator, and lacks an independent operational criterion for unlimited open-ended novelty.
Formal definition leaves mathcal-G observability, Omega extraction, causal identification, Causal Permeability endpoint identity and quantitative phase-transition threshold unresolved.
Conceptual model lacks a general possibility-space-change metric and does not resolve Causal Permeability to a corpus endpoint.
Benchmark leaves mechanism-challenge identity, mechanism-space cardinality, residual-capability measurement, treatment equivalence and statistical protocol unresolved.
Experimental design lacks validated metric mappings/causal treatment isolation, and its multiple-learning-strategy proof-of-concept is not directly instantiated by frozen code.
Falsification document explicitly notes mathcal-G unobservability and leaves weak/strong CTC estimation, independent open-endedness criteria and statistical decisions unresolved.
Implementation plan contains Constraint-vs-Causal Transition nomenclature drift, planned-vs-current module divergence and unvalidated metric definitions.
Related-field comparisons are conceptual/source-authored and do not establish empirical superiority or exhaustive literature coverage.
Simulator architecture proposes unvalidated metrics and lacks a generally justified observable representation of mathcal G.
Evolution log contains Constraint–Trajectory-vs-Causal Transition nomenclature drift, unoperationalized causal-mass counterfactuals and provenance-limited conceptual-result reporting.

basic_experiment.py imports absent APIs, constructs Environment with incompatible signature, shares mutable environment across conditions and prints an 'Observed' causal label from a non-independent permeability-score comparison.
export_results.py hard-coded positive example data has no run provenance and is not an observed result.
plot_results.py uses explicitly placeholder performance/mechanism histories, not experimental observations.
YAML contains many settings not consumed by frozen runner, an unapplied seed, and 100x500 scale distinct from runner-local 20x100 defaults.
run_ctc_benchmark.py imports absent APIs, calls incompatible Environment constructor, shares mutable environment sequentially and performs unseeded random difficulty selection.
run_from_config.py calls target Causal Permeability Principle benchmark and consumes only a subset of YAML experimental settings.
requirements header calls project Causal Permeability Principle without explicit identity resolution to CTC.
Gitignore suppresses normal results/plots/CSV/JSON artifacts, so repository absence cannot identify no execution.

ctc_core lacks imported agent classes and expected AdaptiveAgent result API; adapt returns None; permeability equals treatment switch; mechanism expansion is directly treatment-coded by constraint source.
environment.py API conflicts with callers and history appends mutable state references rather than copied snapshots.

metrics.py uses treatment assignment as permeability, list size as mechanism space, supplied/synthetic removal inputs, uncalibrated dependency/composite thresholds and lacks runner-imported calculate_* names.
simulator.py result contract conflicts with AdaptiveAgent, hard-codes removal/dependency values, uses last-step expansion as growth and permits shared mutable environment across conditions.
tests expect incompatible agent/environment/mechanism APIs and ConstraintSignal arithmetic; no frozen CI/test report establishes test execution/pass/failure.
